displayName: Noe Valley corner shop (Victorian belt, ground-floor commercial)
_comment: #475/#487. THIS TEMPLATE EXISTS BECAUSE OF A SCHEMA LIMIT, not because a corner shop wants
its own style. storefront_noe_corner owns the whole ground floor - it carries its own recessed
entry (entrySide/entryWidth/entryLeaves) - so it cannot share floor 0 with
noe_valley_victorian's garage + door, and there is no 'exclusive with' field to say so inside
one template. Splitting into two templates that both admit the belt is the expressible form:
TryMatch collects every admitting template and PickWeighted draws one per building, seeded by
osm_id, so the split is deterministic and a re-import is byte-stable. library.json's
districtTemplateWeights sets the ratio (12:1).
GATED BY NEIGHBORHOOD ONLY. It is not gated to commercial buildings, because it cannot be:
BuildingFactsJson.building_type is the raw OSM `building` tag and reads "yes" for 93.3% of
the 11,111 buildings measured in #472, so compatibility.building_types would either match
everything or nothing. Until #486 bakes a real commercial fact, roughly 1 in 13 buildings in
the Victorian belt - houses included - will be dressed as a shop. Do not add a building_types
filter here expecting it to help; it will silently do nothing.
SIZING (#487). The shopfront is a RULE, not an exact, and sets stretchToFacade: the placement
overwrites the part's `w` with the rule's span in metres before StorefrontGenerator runs, so
the shop is REBUILT at the facade's width - more bays - instead of being scaled to it, which
would also have stretched the bulkhead height and the mullion widths. countMin/countMax 1 make
it exactly one placement, centred in the span.
span 0.15..0.85 rather than the whole frontage for two reasons: storefront_noe_corner's
surround and its 0.80 m chamfered return stand 0.95 m beyond `w` at every width (measured), and
on a corner building FacadeCornerTable.Blocked refuses anything overhanging the corner.
Measured over the 70 storefront placements in chunks_wintest: a 0.70 span fraction is refused
on 2 of them, against 6 for the fixed 4.60 m width this replaces - so the shopfront now both
fits its facade and reaches MORE corner buildings than it did.
Windows start at floor 1: floor 0 is the shopfront.
The Mission and North Beach storefront/bay presets have no template yet - #492.
